Daiichi Ruby, the young lady of the "Noble 
Clan." The mission of her family is to 
achieve results in every field and display 
their majesty as supreme beings.

The same held true in the racing world. 
Her grandmother made a name for herself as 
a legendary Umamusume, and her mother had 
achieved great feats in prestigious races.

Winning with a performance that embodies 
her family's golden rule is her duty. The 
Trainer vows to help shoulder the heavy 
expectations placed upon her.

Amidst heavy public attention, Daiichi 
Ruby held a press conference. Even when 
Daitaku Helios—captivated by her 
running—barged in, she remained unfazed—

Tracing the legacy of her lineage, she 
announces her pursuit of the Triple Tiara 
route. A new chapter in the history of the 
"Noble Lineage" begins now—!
